title: Rowing: the greats overview
d: The greatest Rowing players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
definition: The greatest Rowing players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of Rowing is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how Rowing is played. Greatness here is measured three ways — winning, statistics, and influence — and the truest greats score on all three. Study them not to worship but to learn: every great was once a beginner who mastered fundamentals.

title: Steve Redgrave
d: Steve Redgrave (1984-2000): 5 straight Olympic golds (1984-2000).
definition: Steve Redgrave (1984-2000): 5 straight Olympic golds (1984-2000).
description: Steve Redgrave competed at the top of Rowing from 1984-2000, and the achievement that defines the career is this: 5 straight Olympic golds (1984-2000). What separated Steve Redgrave was not one skill but the complete package — technique hardened by repetition, tactics sharpened by study, and the temperament to deliver when everything is on the line. Young players should study not just the highlights but the habits: the training volume, the professionalism, and the longevity that turned talent into legacy.

title: Steve Redgrave: legacy

definition: Why Steve Redgrave matters to Rowing history.
